Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded in Step 2 that the place of death, Vatican City, became its own country on 11 February 1929, based solely on the signing date of the Lateran Treaty. While the treaty was signed on that date, it did not take effect until 7 June 1929, when it was ratified. This oversight led to a misunderstanding of the actual date Vatican City became fully sovereign, which is crucial to answering the real-world problem accurately. The Planner should have investigated further to confirm the operative date of the treaty's implementation (7 June 1929) rather than prematurely concluding based on the signing date. This initial error propagated throughout the rest of the conversation, as subsequent steps were based on this incorrect assumption.
